newsitem.title: USA: Apple South acquires seafood restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Apple South acquires seafood restaurants.

text.p: Apple South Inc said late on Thursday it had a contract to merge with McCormick & Schmick's restaurants, a chain of 16 seafood restaurants based in Portland, Oregon, for $53 million, comprised of about 90 percent cash and 10 percent stock.
The sellers are New York merchant bank Castle Harlan Inc, the restaurant's co-founders and other members of management, the company said.
The company said it will assume $15 million in debt in the deal and will use existing credit facilities for the cash and debt portions of the transaction.
It said the deal should close before the end of the first quarter.
